name: personal-model-context
description: Recall relevant owner-local Personal Model context on every Codex turn.

interface.shortDescription: Bring relevant local memory into every Codex turn.
interface.longDescription: Loads the owner's behavior model and recent activity when a session starts, then recalls relevant durable memory for every user prompt. Recalled data is supplied to the active Codex conversation and treated as untrusted context.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use my Personal Model context when it is relevant, and verify stale or conflicted memories before relying on them.
